Name: Farm Building - Biogas Plant (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General [/size][/b]
The Biogas Plant is a 5x3 farm building that can be constructed by Robin for 5000g, 300 stone and 30 iron bars. It converts organic resources into fertilizer and battery packs overnight.

[size=4][b]Item processing[/b][/size]
50 wood -> 1 battery pack, 5 basic fertilizer
50 sap -> 1 battery pack, 10 basic fertilizer
25 fiber -> 1 battery pack, 3 basic fertilizer
20 moss -> 1 battery pack, 5 quality fertilizer
50 hay -> 1 battery pack, 5 basic fertilizer
20 green algae -> 1 battery pack, 5 basic fertilizer
5 white algae -> 1 battery pack, 3 quality fertilizer
10 seaweed -> 1 battery pack, 5 quality fertilizer
5 crops/forage/flowers (any) -> 1 battery pack, 1 deluxe fertilizer

[b][size=3]Permissions[/size][/b]
If you want to make your own recolor/retexture, translation, add items to be processed, or make any other kind of change to this mod and post it, you are free to do so and use my assets, as long as your mod is an add-on (using my mod as a dependency) and doesn't just copy/replace this one. Please only use my assets for the things you are changing.

Enjoy!
